Name: Johanan, Son of Josiah
Summary: Firstborn son of Josiah, named among the sons of Josiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:15: Firstborn son of Josiah, named among the sons of Josiah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Johanan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
